messages:
Alex Rivera: Quick sync — landing copy round for Hosted / Dedicated / Private. We need tight one-line benchmark claims for each page, final CTAs, and a routing note for inbound leads. Target: freeze by EOD Tue. Can we triage?
Priya Shah: +1. I can take Hosted API and webinar promo copy. Will try to keep benchmark line explicit (latency/cost).
Jon Kim: I’ll own Dedicated and the pricing callout. Also need a sentence about SLA/backups.
Riley (growth): I can map inbound routing — demo vs trial bucket. Question: do we send Hosted signups to self-serve, and Dedicated leads to AE?
Sam - copy: For Private page, keep tone enterprise-safe. Suggest: "Private deployment — VPC & on-prem options with enterprise SLAs." Short.
Alex Rivera: Riley: yes, default routing is Hosted -> self-serve, Dedicated -> AE, Private -> AE + security lead. But create fallback rule: high-MRR or compliance keywords route to AE immediately.
Priya Shah: Draft for Hosted benchmark line: "99th pct latency under 120ms for 1k RPS workloads (typical)." Too technical?
Sam - copy: I’d soften a bit: "Production-grade latency — sub-200ms 99th percentile on common workloads." We can keep a technical footnote in the docs link.
Jon Kim: Dedicated page benchmark line: "Dedicated pools with predictable throughput — sustained X tokens/s per GPU (contact for sizing)." Replace X with recommended number from infra.
Riley (growth): Inbound routing matrix (sketch):
```
if message contains: "Compliance","SOC2","HIPAA" -> route to AE + security
else if org_size >= 250 or mrr_predicted > 5k -> AE
else if interest == "embed" or "quick test" -> self-serve
```
Alex Rivera: Nice. Also need CTA variants to test on each page. Sam, can you draft 2 variants per page? One product-led, one enterprise-led.
Sam - copy: On it. Draft examples: 
- Hosted: "Start building — free credits" / "Explore hosted API performance"
- Dedicated: "Request capacity pricing" / "See predictable throughput"
- Private: "Talk to sales" / "Request security brief"
Priya Shah: Webinar blurb for Hosted: "Live demo + benchmarks: Reduce inference cost by 30% — hands-on walkthrough of batching & caching." Date TBD.
Jon Kim: Add a case snippet on Dedicated page: "Customer X reduced token cost by 2.1x after switching to reserved pools." Need permission to use anonymized metric.
Riley (growth): For tracking, append ?source=landing_A/B to all CTA links. We'll pass UTM to SFDC mapping.
Alex Rivera: Next steps: Sam to share copy drafts in this thread by EOD today. Priya to draft webinar blurb + three short headlines. Jon to get the Dedicated throughput numbers from infra. Riley to produce routing YAML and UTM plan. I'll assemble final page outlines and hand to design.
Sam - copy: Uploading drafts in 2hrs.
launch-bot: Reminder: copy freeze deadline set for 1758089600 (Tue 11:59pm UTC).
Alex Rivera: Thanks team — small focused round, but critical. :rocket:
